title: ro ro kehte the muslim ke pyaare
body:
ro ro kehte the muslim ke pyaare, chord de ham yateemo ko zalim
baandh ta kyu hai gesu hamaare, chord de ham yateemo ko zalim
hamko pehlu me apne bithaale , haath sar pa hamaare phiraade
ham ghareebo ke dil ki dua le, chord de ham yateemo ko zalim
<<DIVIDER>>
tujh pe haq ki rahegi inaayat, hogi qushnood roohe risalat
tere bache rahenge salamat, chord de ham yateemo ko zalim
haath mat baandh ham beqata hai, bepidar aur aseere bala hai
ahlebaithe rasoole quda hai, chord de ham yateemo ko zalim
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad maadar ki jab unko aayi, sar jhukaa kar kahe dono bhai
hai rasoole quda ki dohaai, chord de ham yateemo ko zalim
tujhko roohe nabi ki qasam hai, shaahe mardaa'n ali ki qasam hai
tujh ko haq ke wali ki qasam hai, chord de ham yateemo ko zalim
